images.caption:
Sampson Orchestral Society at the Exhibition Concert Hall, Bowen Hills, 1923
This photograph shows the pipe organs at the Exhibition Concert Hall in Bowen Hils, 1923. The Sampson Orchestral Society members are photographed on stage in front of the pipe organs.

images.filename: StateLibQld 1 394285 Original Exhibition Building, Bowen Hills ca. 1877.jpg
images.caption:
Original Exhibition Building, Bowen Hills ca. 1877
The Exhibition Building as it appeared after the construction of a tower for the 1877 Exhibition. It was destroyed by fire 13 June, 1888. (Description supplied with photograph).
images.alt:
Original Exhibition Building, Bowen Hills ca. 1877
